name: budget-watch
description: Appends a [budget] line the model reads when context fill or a session rate-limit window crosses a band, and resumes work after a five-hour limit resets.

contextStart.title: First context band (%)
contextStart.description: The context fill at which the first [budget] context line is appended, as a whole percentage of the window.

contextStep.title: Context band step (%)
contextStep.description: How many percentage points of context fill between one [budget] context line and the next.

fiveHourBands.title: Five-hour window bands
fiveHourBands.description: Comma-separated percentages of the five-hour rate-limit window at which a [budget] session line is appended.

sevenDayBands.title: Seven-day window bands
sevenDayBands.description: Comma-separated percentages of the seven-day rate-limit window at which a [budget] session line is appended.

autoResume.title: Auto-resume after a limit
autoResume.description: When a turn dies on a rate limit, submit the resume prompt once the window resets. /budget resume off cancels a planned resume.

sevenDayResumeHours.title: Seven-day resume horizon (hours)
sevenDayResumeHours.description: Auto-resume after a seven-day limit only when its reset is within this many hours; otherwise the session stays stopped.

resumePrompt.title: Resume prompt
resumePrompt.description: The prompt submitted when the limit resets.
resumePrompt.default: The session rate limit has reset. Resume the work in progress from the handoff on the active bead. If there is no handoff, report the current state and stop.
